ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

3. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

4. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

5. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.

6. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

7. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

9. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

10. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Only one word repeated

12. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — went

6. C — A person, place, thing, or idea

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

11. B — One main idea with supporting sentences

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive Listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Activities at home; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
